## Method

- Total alpha staked: sum of every `TotalHotkeyAlpha(hotkey, netuid)` value.
- Pending alpha: `PendingServerEmission + PendingValidatorEmission + PendingRootAlphaDivs + PendingOwnerCut + PendingBasketDeposits`.
- Calculated alpha staked: `SubnetAlphaOut - AlphaBurned - pending alpha - SubnetProtocolAlpha`.
- Delta: `sum(TotalHotkeyAlpha) - calculated alpha staked`.
- Discrepancy: `abs(delta) / calculated alpha staked × 100`.
- Every storage value was read at the same finalized block hash shown above.
